field_conventions.station_no: Numeric suffix of existing ST identifier, stable and unique across 250 stations; not line sequence.
field_conventions.construction_start_date: ISO day, month or year when available. SECTION PROXY, not station-specific. Read precision, relation and scope. on_or_before and after_tendering/after_tender_award are bounds/context, not exact start dates. Null is unknown.
field_conventions.construction_start_date_interchanges: Scalar uses first-opened line when known, otherwise earliest available section proxy. See station_line_history for every line.
field_conventions.station_opening_date: YYYY-MM-DD earliest recorded passenger-service opening of this station feature. Conflicting source dates flagged. Inauguration is not substituted.
field_conventions.station_opening_year: Integer derived only from actual recorded opening; future forecasts kept separately.
field_conventions.planned_openings_by_route: Source forecasts, not verified actual or guaranteed dates. Blue/Pink source conflicts noted.
field_conventions.station_line_history: One object per route membership, including sequence, dates, scope, forecast, source and caveats.
field_conventions.line_color: Original route stroke hex values, semicolon-separated in station route order. No styling or colours changed.
field_conventions.location_coordinates: Exact duplicate of input point coordinates in [longitude, latitude] order; no geocoding or movement.
field_conventions.source_status: Statements as reported by the article, not independent real-time verification.
field_conventions.suburban_dates: Null: Namma Metro article is not evidence of suburban project dates. Existing mainline rail station inauguration is not the suburban opening.
